specDef.name: sheetco
specDef.title: SheetCo
specDef.product: SheetCo builds a small spreadsheet engine. The team designs its own module split and interfaces in the kickoff meeting; requirements arrive in waves.
specDef.context: The product: Sheet, a spreadsheet engine, specified by behaviour only in live/bench5r/SPEC5.md (read all of it; it grows by waves, and every new wave is announced on the company channel and in your brief). There is no module spec: the kickoff meeting MTG-1 decides the split into four module slots (A-D) plus the integration module (SHEET), every interface between them, and which slot owns which behaviour; ARCH.md (order ARCH, in live/bench5r/work/ARCH/) records those decisions and is the contract. Each slot's module lives in live/bench5r/work/MOD-<slot>/<file named in ARCH.md>; modules import each other by relative paths ARCH.md gives. Shipped modules are in live/bench5r/shipped/. Hidden acceptance tests run only on the integrated sheet and report failing categories; every shipped order is tested again after each later ship. When a wave's failure is in another slot's module, say so in your report: the slot's owner fixes it. The org is in ORG.md.

__map.title: Minutes: Kickoff: Sheet's design
__map.body:
# Kickoff: Sheet's design (MTG-1)

chair: lead · invited: lead, dev-1, dev-2, reviewer · absent: none · room: design-room

## 1. The module split: what behaviour each of slots A-D owns, now (wave 1) and as later waves add references, functions, recalculation and cycles; which slot each builder owns
Round 1:
- dev-2: Split by pipeline stage so each later wave lands mostly in ONE slot. A = PARSER (formula text -> AST): tokenizer, precedence (cmp < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc, unary binds to the next atom so -2^2=4), number syntax (1.2.3 bad), strings, TRUE/FALSE, call syntax NAME(args) parsed now even though wave 1 has no functions (so #NAME? is an eval decision, not a parse failure), and from wave 2 cell refs/ranges plus refs(ast) listing referenced cells. B = VALUES: the value/error representation, cell-name validation/normalisation (A1..Z99, case-insensitive, no leading zero), literal parsing for set() (" -2.5 ", .5, 12abc stays text), coercions (toNumber with ""->0, bool->1/0, numeric text; toText; case-insensitive compare), round9 and display(). C = EVALUATOR: walks the AST over B values, operator semantics, error propagation (left error wins), non-finite -> #VALUE!, #DIV/0!, and the function table (wave 1: every call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions are added here only). D = STORE + DEPENDENCY GRAPH: raw text/AST/value per cell, wave 1 just storage; wave 2-3 dependents, recalc order (topological), cycle detection. SHEET = thin glue: createSheet() wires B (names, literals, display), A, C, D. Ownership (balances wave-1 load and keeps related reasoning together): dev-1 owns A and D (structural: syntax and graph), dev-2 owns B and C (semantics: values and evaluation). SHEET owned by lead (or whoever ARCH names) since it only composes. Rationale: hidden tests fail by category; with this split a failing category maps to one owner.
- reviewer: Split by pipeline stage so each later wave lands in one or two slots, not all four. A = formula syntax (work/MOD-A/parse.mjs): tokenizer + precedence parser (comparison < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc; unary binds to the atom so -2^2=4; 1.2.3 and unbalanced parens = parse error), cell-name validation/canonicalisation (A1..Z99, case-insensitive, no leading zero); wave 2 adds ref/range/call nodes here only. B = value model (work/MOD-B/values.mjs): error values, literal-input parsing (" -2.5 ", .5, 7 -> number; "12abc","TRUE" -> text), coercion (""->0, bool->1/0, numeric text->number, else #VALUE!), every operator incl. case-insensitive string compare and & text forms, non-finite -> #VALUE!, round-to-9, display(). C = evaluator (work/MOD-C/eval.mjs): walks the AST, left operand first so left error wins, unknown call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions live in C (functions.mjs beside it), refs resolved through a callback so C never sees storage. D = cell store + dependency graph (work/MOD-D/store.mjs): inputs, cached values, wave 2/3 dependents, recalculation order, cycle detection. In wave 1 D is thin: that is deliberate headroom, it absorbs waves 2-3. SHEET = wiring only (createSheet, throw on bad names). Builders: dev-1 owns A + C (they share the AST contract, one person avoids drift); dev-2 owns B + D. Lead owns SHEET. Reviewer checks each slot against SPEC5 examples and the ARCH contract, and names the owning slot on any failing category.
- dev-1: Split along the pipeline so each slot grows in exactly one wave and nobody edits another slot to add a feature. A = syntax (MOD-A/parse.mjs): tokenizer + precedence-climbing parser -> AST, cell-name validation/normalisation; from wave 1 it already parses calls NAME(args) (so =FOO(1) gives a call node -> #NAME?, not a syntax error), and wave 2 adds ref/range nodes here only, plus refs(ast) listing referenced cells. B = values (MOD-B/values.mjs): value representation, error values, coercion (toNumber/toText/compare), the operators as pure functions, literal-input parsing for set (" -2.5 " -> -2.5, "12abc" stays text), round9 and display. C = evaluation (MOD-C/eval.mjs): walks the AST using B, resolves refs/ranges through a context callback, owns the function registry (wave 2 functions are added here; wave 1 registry empty -> #NAME?). D = dependencies (MOD-D/graph.mjs): dependency graph, recalc order after a set, cycle detection (wave 3); in wave 1 it is trivial but its interface is fixed now so SHEET does not change shape later. SHEET (SHEET/sheet.mjs): createSheet, cell store {text, ast, value}, wires A->C->D, throws on bad names. Owners: dev-1 takes A and C (parser and evaluator share the AST contract, fewest cross-owner handoffs); dev-2 takes B and D; SHEET goes to whoever finishes first, default dev-2 since it mostly drives D. Wave-1 critical path is A+B+C; D can be a stub that returns [cell] as the recalc order.
- lead: A=parse.mjs: cell names + formula text -> AST (wave2+: refs, ranges, function calls). B=values.mjs: value/error representation, literal input parsing, coercion, operators, display formatting. C=eval.mjs: AST -> value via a getCell callback; function library (wave2). D=graph.mjs: cell store + dependency graph, recalc order, cycle detection (wave2/3). SHEET wires them. Owners: dev-1 ARCH,A,C; dev-2 B,D,SHEET.
**Decision:** Pipeline split, all four positions agree. Slot A = work/MOD-A/parse.mjs (owner dev-1): tokenizer + precedence parser (comparison < & < + - < * / < ^ right-assoc; unary +/- binds to the next atom so -2^2=4; 1.2.3, unbalanced parens, trailing junk = bad syntax), strings, TRUE/FALSE any case, NAME(args) call nodes parsed in wave 1, cell-name validation normCell; wave 2 adds ref/range nodes and refs(ast) here only. Slot B = work/MOD-B/values.mjs (owner dev-2): value and error representation, parseInput for non-formula set text, coercion, every operator as a pure function (left error wins, non-finite -> #VALUE!, x/0 -> #DIV/0!, case-insensitive string compare, & text forms), round9, display. Slot C = work/MOD-C/eval.mjs (owner dev-1): walks the AST using B, evaluates left before right, resolves refs/ranges only through a ctx callback, owns the function table (wave 1 empty: every call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions are added here only). Slot D = work/MOD-D/graph.mjs (owner dev-2): dependency graph, recalc order, cycle detection; wave 1 is a working but trivial graph with the final interface. SHEET = work/SHEET/sheet.mjs (owner dev-2): createSheet, the cell store {text, ast, value}, throws Error on bad names, wiring only. ARCH.md (O-1) is written by dev-1. Builder runs: dev-1 O-1, O-2, O-4; dev-2 O-3, O-5, O-6.

## 2. The interfaces: every exported function with its arguments and results, how values and errors are represented, how modules import each other (relative paths), and who writes ARCH.md
Round 1:
- dev-2: Values (owned by B, used everywhere): number = JS number (finite), text = JS string, boolean = JS boolean, empty = "" , error = frozen object {error:"#DIV/0!"|"#VALUE!"|"#NAME?"|later "#REF!"/"#CIRC!"...}; B exports ERR constants so errors compare by identity or by .error. Files and exports: work/MOD-B/values.mjs: normCell(name)->"A1" uppercase or null; parseLiteral(text)->number|string ("" stays ""); isError(v); makeError(code); toNumber(v)->number|error; toText(v)->string; compareValues(a,b)->-1|0|1 (case-insensitive strings, else numbers; caller handles errors); round9(n); display(v)->string. work/MOD-A/parse.mjs: parse(src) where src is the text AFTER "=", returns AST or {type:"error",code:"#VALUE!"} on bad syntax (never throws). AST nodes: {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op:"-"|"+",arg} {type:"binary",op:"+"|"-"|"*"|"/"|"^"|"&"|"="|"<>"|"<"|">"|"<="|">=",left,right} {type:"call",name (uppercased),args:[]}; reserved for wave 2: {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to}; refs(ast)->string[] of normalised cells (wave 1 returns []). work/MOD-C/eval.mjs: evaluate(ast, ctx)->value where ctx={get(cell)->value} (unused in wave 1); final numbers rounded via round9; imports ../MOD-B/values.mjs. work/MOD-D/store.mjs: createStore()->{setCell(cell,{raw,ast,value}), getCell(cell)->record|undefined, clear(cell), setDeps(cell,cells[]), dependents(cell)->cells in recalc order, cycles()->Set} (graph methods are no-ops/empty in wave 1 but the signatures are fixed now). Imports are relative between sibling module dirs: "../MOD-B/values.mjs" etc., and SHEET imports "../MOD-A/parse.mjs","../MOD-B/values.mjs","../MOD-C/eval.mjs","../MOD-D/store.mjs" - this must hold identically in shipped/ (same dir layout), please confirm. set()/get() throw Error on bad names via normCell. ARCH.md: the lead (chair) writes it right after the meeting from the minutes; builders propose additions by order, the reviewer checks code against it. Changes to an interface need an ARCH amendment before code.
- reviewer: Values: number | string | boolean | SheetError. B exports class SheetError {code} with frozen singletons ERR.DIV0 ("#DIV/0!"), ERR.VALUE ("#VALUE!"), ERR.NAME ("#NAME?"), reserved ERR.REF/ERR.CYCLE for later waves, and isError(v). Errors are objects, NOT strings, so text "#DIV/0!" typed by a user stays distinguishable; toString() returns the code. (ARCH must state what get() returns for errors; I recommend the SheetError object, display() gives the code.) Empty cell = "". A exports parse(src) -> AST, never throws: nodes {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} {type:"call",name(uppercased),args} {type:"error",code} for bad syntax; reserved for wave 2 {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to}; plus normCell(name) -> "A1" or null, and refsOf(ast) -> cell names (for D). B exports parseInput(text) -> ""|number|string, toNumber(v), toText(v), unary(op,v), binary(op,a,b) (all -> value incl. errors, never throw), round9(n), display(v) -> string. C exports evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value, ctx = {get(cell)->value, range(from,to)->value[][]} (wave 1 ctx unused). D exports createStore({parse, evaluate}) -> {setInput(cell,text), input(cell), value(cell)} handling recalculation internally. SHEET: createSheet() validates via normCell (throw Error), routes "=" text to parse/store, else parseInput. Imports: relative only, ../MOD-A/parse.mjs, ../MOD-B/values.mjs, ../MOD-C/eval.mjs, ../MOD-D/store.mjs from SHEET and between modules; shipped/ must keep the same MOD-<slot>/ layout or these paths break — ARCH must say so. Dependency direction A,B <- C <- D <- SHEET, no cycles. ARCH.md written by lead as chair right after the meeting; reviewer checks it against SPEC5 before any build starts; changes to an interface only via ARCH edit, never in module code.
- dev-1: Values: number (finite JS number), string, boolean, "" for empty, and errors as frozen singleton objects from B: ERR.DIV0/ERR.VALUE/ERR.NAME (later ERR.REF, ERR.CYCLE), shape {error:"#DIV/0!"}; isError(v) is the only test, display(v) returns v.error. Modules never throw for sheet-level errors; only SHEET throws (bad cell name). B values.mjs exports: ERR, isError(v), parseInput(text)->number|string|"", toNumber(v)->number|error ("" ->0, bool->1/0, numeric text, else ERR.VALUE), toText(v)->string|error, binary(op,a,b)->value (op in + - * / ^ & = <> < > <= >=; left error wins; non-finite -> ERR.VALUE; /0 -> ERR.DIV0), unary(op,v), round9(n), display(v)->string. A parse.mjs exports: parse(src /*text after =*/)->AST, never throws; bad syntax returns {type:"error",code:"#VALUE!"}. Nodes: {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} {type:"call",name /*uppercase*/,args:[AST]}; wave 2 adds {type:"ref",cell:"A1"} {type:"range",from,to}. Also normCell(name)->"A1"|null and refs(ast)->string[]. C eval.mjs exports: evaluate(ast, ctx)->value, ctx={ get(cell)->value, range(from,to)->value[][] }; functions: registerFunction(name, fn(args, ctx)) or a FUNCTIONS map, unknown name -> ERR.NAME. D graph.mjs exports createGraph()->{ setDeps(cell, cells[]), recalcOrder(cell)->string[] (cell then dependents, topological), cyclic()->Set<string> }. SHEET stores round9(evaluate(...)) so refs see the same value get returns. Imports by relative path only: C imports "../MOD-B/values.mjs"; SHEET imports "../MOD-A/parse.mjs", "../MOD-B/values.mjs", "../MOD-C/eval.mjs", "../MOD-D/graph.mjs"; A and D import nothing (A imports B only if needed for ERR codes). Lead writes ARCH.md from the decided positions; each slot owner reviews the section for their slot before builds start; changes to an interface go through the lead and ARCH.md, never by editing another slot.
- lead: Values: JS number | string | boolean; "" empty; errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} made by B.err(code), tested by B.isError(v). Imports by relative path ../MOD-X/<file>.mjs. dev-1 writes ARCH.md from these minutes.
**Decision:** Values: number (finite JS number), string, boolean, "" for empty, error = frozen singleton from B: ERR.DIV0 {error:"#DIV/0!"}, ERR.VALUE {error:"#VALUE!"}, ERR.NAME {error:"#NAME?"}, reserved ERR.REF "#REF!" and ERR.CYCLE "#CYCLE!" for later waves; each error object has toString() returning its code; isError(v) is the only test. get() returns the error object; display() returns its code. Modules never throw; only SHEET throws (bad cell name). B values.mjs exports: ERR, isError(v), parseInput(text)->""|number|string, toNumber(v)->number|error, toText(v)->string|error, compare(a,b)->-1|0|1|error, unary(op,v)->value, binary(op,a,b)->value for op in + - * / ^ & = <> < > <= >=, round9(n)->number, display(v)->string. A parse.mjs exports: parse(src) where src is the text after "=", returns AST and never throws; bad syntax returns {type:"error",code:"#VALUE!"}. Nodes: {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} {type:"call",name (uppercase),args:[AST]}; wave 2: {type:"ref",cell:"A1"} {type:"range",from,to}. Also normCell(name)->"A1"|null and refs(ast)->string[] (wave 1 returns []). C eval.mjs exports evaluate(ast, ctx)->value with ctx={get(cell)->value, range(from,to)->value[][]}, and FUNCTIONS (a name -> fn(args, ctx) map; unknown name -> ERR.NAME); results that are numbers go through round9. D graph.mjs exports createGraph()->{setDeps(cell, cells[]), recalcOrder(cell)->string[] (cell first, then dependents topologically), cyclic()->Set<string>}. Imports by relative path only: A imports nothing; C imports ../MOD-B/values.mjs; D imports nothing; SHEET imports ../MOD-A/parse.mjs, ../MOD-B/values.mjs, ../MOD-C/eval.mjs, ../MOD-D/graph.mjs. shipped/ keeps the same MOD-<slot>/ layout. dev-1 writes ARCH.md (O-1) from these minutes; interface changes go through the lead and an ARCH.md edit, never by editing another slot. · actions: ISS-7
- rule for ARCH*: {"mustInclude":["parse.mjs","values.mjs","eval.mjs","graph.mjs","../MOD-B/values.mjs","isError","createGraph","evaluate","normCell"]} (checked by code; tightened O-1)

__map.body: node meta.mjs check --order=O-1 fails with "missing work/ARCH/page.md" and carries an unrelated Venus false-claim rule; the O-1 accept criteria and MTG-1 require work/ARCH/ARCH.md, which exists and passes the mustInclude rule. Required: point the O-1 check at ARCH.md (I did not create a duplicate page.md).

comments.text: yes: Claim verified. work/ARCH/ARCH.md exists and contains all 14 mustInclude strings (checked by hand, case-insensitive); the O-1 accept text and MTG-1 name ARCH.md, so test1 reading work/ARCH/page.md is a check defect, not a work defect. Required fix: O-1 checks must carry file:"ARCH.md" (runTextChecks already supports checks.file; it defaults to page.md). No CLI command lets lead set this, so the orderer (cos) / kernel owner must apply it, then re-run test1. Do NOT create a duplicate page.md: two copies of the contract would drift. The Venus knownFalse rule is the company-wide escape list applied to every text check; ARCH.md does not match it, so it is harmless and stays. dev-1: no change to ARCH.md needed; hold O-1 at build until the check is retargeted.

# Kickoff: Sheet's design (MTG-1)

chair: lead · invited: lead, dev-1, dev-2, reviewer · absent: none · room: design-room

## 1. The module split: what behaviour each of slots A-D owns, now (wave 1) and as later waves add references, functions, recalculation and cycles; which slot each builder owns
Round 1:
- dev-2: Split by pipeline stage so each later wave lands mostly in ONE slot. A = PARSER (formula text -> AST): tokenizer, precedence (cmp < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc, unary binds to the next atom so -2^2=4), number syntax (1.2.3 bad), strings, TRUE/FALSE, call syntax NAME(args) parsed now even though wave 1 has no functions (so #NAME? is an eval decision, not a parse failure), and from wave 2 cell refs/ranges plus refs(ast) listing referenced cells. B = VALUES: the value/error representation, cell-name validation/normalisation (A1..Z99, case-insensitive, no leading zero), literal parsing for set() (" -2.5 ", .5, 12abc stays text), coercions (toNumber with ""->0, bool->1/0, numeric text; toText; case-insensitive compare), round9 and display(). C = EVALUATOR: walks the AST over B values, operator semantics, error propagation (left error wins), non-finite -> #VALUE!, #DIV/0!, and the function table (wave 1: every call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions are added here only). D = STORE + DEPENDENCY GRAPH: raw text/AST/value per cell, wave 1 just storage; wave 2-3 dependents, recalc order (topological), cycle detection. SHEET = thin glue: createSheet() wires B (names, literals, display), A, C, D. Ownership (balances wave-1 load and keeps related reasoning together): dev-1 owns A and D (structural: syntax and graph), dev-2 owns B and C (semantics: values and evaluation). SHEET owned by lead (or whoever ARCH names) since it only composes. Rationale: hidden tests fail by category; with this split a failing category maps to one owner.
- reviewer: Split by pipeline stage so each later wave lands in one or two slots, not all four. A = formula syntax (work/MOD-A/parse.mjs): tokenizer + precedence parser (comparison < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc; unary binds to the atom so -2^2=4; 1.2.3 and unbalanced parens = parse error), cell-name validation/canonicalisation (A1..Z99, case-insensitive, no leading zero); wave 2 adds ref/range/call nodes here only. B = value model (work/MOD-B/values.mjs): error values, literal-input parsing (" -2.5 ", .5, 7 -> number; "12abc","TRUE" -> text), coercion (""->0, bool->1/0, numeric text->number, else #VALUE!), every operator incl. case-insensitive string compare and & text forms, non-finite -> #VALUE!, round-to-9, display(). C = evaluator (work/MOD-C/eval.mjs): walks the AST, left operand first so left error wins, unknown call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions live in C (functions.mjs beside it), refs resolved through a callback so C never sees storage. D = cell store + dependency graph (work/MOD-D/store.mjs): inputs, cached values, wave 2/3 dependents, recalculation order, cycle detection. In wave 1 D is thin: that is deliberate headroom, it absorbs waves 2-3. SHEET = wiring only (createSheet, throw on bad names). Builders: dev-1 owns A + C (they share the AST contract, one person avoids drift); dev-2 owns B + D. Lead owns SHEET. Reviewer checks each slot against SPEC5 examples and the ARCH contract, and names the owning slot on any failing category.
- dev-1: Split along the pipeline so each slot grows in exactly one wave and nobody edits another slot to add a feature. A = syntax (MOD-A/parse.mjs): tokenizer + precedence-climbing parser -> AST, cell-name validation/normalisation; from wave 1 it already parses calls NAME(args) (so =FOO(1) gives a call node -> #NAME?, not a syntax error), and wave 2 adds ref/range nodes here only, plus refs(ast) listing referenced cells. B = values (MOD-B/values.mjs): value representation, error values, coercion (toNumber/toText/compare), the operators as pure functions, literal-input parsing for set (" -2.5 " -> -2.5, "12abc" stays text), round9 and display. C = evaluation (MOD-C/eval.mjs): walks the AST using B, resolves refs/ranges through a context callback, owns the function registry (wave 2 functions are added here; wave 1 registry empty -> #NAME?). D = dependencies (MOD-D/graph.mjs): dependency graph, recalc order after a set, cycle detection (wave 3); in wave 1 it is trivial but its interface is fixed now so SHEET does not change shape later. SHEET (SHEET/sheet.mjs): createSheet, cell store {text, ast, value}, wires A->C->D, throws on bad names. Owners: dev-1 takes A and C (parser and evaluator share the AST contract, fewest cross-owner handoffs); dev-2 takes B and D; SHEET goes to whoever finishes first, default dev-2 since it mostly drives D. Wave-1 critical path is A+B+C; D can be a stub that returns [cell] as the recalc order.
- lead: A=parse.mjs: cell names + formula text -> AST (wave2+: refs, ranges, function calls). B=values.mjs: value/error representation, literal input parsing, coercion, operators, display formatting. C=eval.mjs: AST -> value via a getCell callback; function library (wave2). D=graph.mjs: cell store + dependency graph, recalc order, cycle detection (wave2/3). SHEET wires them. Owners: dev-1 ARCH,A,C; dev-2 B,D,SHEET.
**Decision:** Pipeline split, all four positions agree. Slot A = work/MOD-A/parse.mjs (owner dev-1): tokenizer + precedence parser (comparison < & < + - < * / < ^ right-assoc; unary +/- binds to the next atom so -2^2=4; 1.2.3, unbalanced parens, trailing junk = bad syntax), strings, TRUE/FALSE any case, NAME(args) call nodes parsed in wave 1, cell-name validation normCell; wave 2 adds ref/range nodes and refs(ast) here only. Slot B = work/MOD-B/values.mjs (owner dev-2): value and error representation, parseInput for non-formula set text, coercion, every operator as a pure function (left error wins, non-finite -> #VALUE!, x/0 -> #DIV/0!, case-insensitive string compare, & text forms), round9, display. Slot C = work/MOD-C/eval.mjs (owner dev-1): walks the AST using B, evaluates left before right, resolves refs/ranges only through a ctx callback, owns the function table (wave 1 empty: every call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions are added here only). Slot D = work/MOD-D/graph.mjs (owner dev-2): dependency graph, recalc order, cycle detection; wave 1 is a working but trivial graph with the final interface. SHEET = work/SHEET/sheet.mjs (owner dev-2): createSheet, the cell store {text, ast, value}, throws Error on bad names, wiring only. ARCH.md (O-1) is written by dev-1. Builder runs: dev-1 O-1, O-2, O-4; dev-2 O-3, O-5, O-6.
